divergence_justification: Judge accepted the contested divergence: mimic-fhir/sql/fhir_observation_labevents.sql:15 casts labevents.charttime through TIMESTAMPTZ and line 121 writes the irreversibly DST-normalized value to Observation.effectiveDateTime; fhir_specimen_lab.sql:18,58 repeats the loss. FHIR retains only labevent_id, so normalized 03:xx cannot be distinguished from genuine 03:xx and exact source ordering and 48-hour/7-day window membership are unrecoverable. The full run reproduced 599447/599607 rows identically (99.9733%); 160 conflicts comprise charttime 145, creat 1, prior-48-hour 17, prior-seven-day 9, with 138 directly replay-attributed and 21 of the remaining 22 explained as downstream window effects; the final difference is within comparator tolerance.
